title: Connect existing runtime
purpose: Add a truST runtime that is already running on another computer or controller. truST checks the address before it is shown as connected.

fields.label: Runtime address
fields.help: Host name or IP plus port. Advanced: tcp://host:port or unix:///path/to/socket.

fields.label: Runtime auth token (optional)
fields.help: Paste the token configured for that runtime. Leave this empty when the runtime does not require one. VS Code stores it securely and never shows it on the canvas.

note: If you do not know the address, use Discover instead.
